name: The Bubble Wrap Mountain
description: A surreal mountain range made of bubble wrap invites tiny hikers to pop their way along the trail.
prompt: Surreal mountain range made entirely of translucent bubble wrap, hikers in tiny colorful jackets popping bubbles on a trail, glossy peaks, soft pink sky, playful tactile details, whimsical 3D render, no text, no logos.
caption: The most satisfying mountain to climb is the one you can pop. 🫧⛰️
